page_review.title: door door metal
page_review.author: Mehdi Shahsavan
page_review.download_modal_terms: Author must be credited. Commercial use is allowed.
page_review.visible_geometry: One dark metal leaf in a rectangular frame, narrow vertical upper window, horizontal push bar and lower metal kick plate. Exact component ownership, hinge and size require local inspection.

license_dependency_review: Four 2048 px texture maps are packaged inside the CC BY download; no separately stated map terms appear on the source page. USDZ metadata gives author ahmagh2e, CC-BY-4.0 and the same source URL.
local_geometry_review: Inspection attempt 000002 has 3338 triangles and three connected components. Component 0 is the horizontal moving bar; component 2 is the narrow window plane. Component 1 welds the modeled U-frame to the leaf. Reviewed whole-face bounds select 66 original leaf faces, leaving 30 original frame faces, without changing source coordinates, UVs or materials.
